mapper.sql: id, locale_code, locale_name, native_name, sort_no, is_default, status, remark, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted

sql.where: deleted = 0 AND locale_code like concat('%', #{localeCode}, '%') AND locale_name like concat('%', #{localeName}, '%') AND status = #{status}

mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_i18n_locale WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM sys_i18n_locale WHERE locale_code = #{localeCode} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM sys_i18n_locale WHERE status = '0' AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_no ASC, locale_code ASC
SELECT FROM sys_i18n_locale WHERE is_default = 'Y' AND status = '0' AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM sys_i18n_locale
ORDER BY sort_no ASC, locale_code ASC

SELECT FROM sys_i18n_locale
ORDER BY sort_no ASC, locale_code ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_i18n_locale (id, locale_code, locale_name, native_name, sort_no, is_default, status, remark, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{localeCode}, #{localeName}, #{nativeName}, #{sortNo}, #{isDefault}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt}, #{deleted})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_i18n_locale SET deleted = 1, updated_at = now(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE sys_i18n_locale SET is_default = 'N', updated_at = now(3) WHERE is_default = 'Y' AND deleted = 0
